references.observed: ESM gives 126.1 m rockfill height, two units, 459 m maximum and 432 m minimum operating pool. The exterior photos show pale rockfill, the circular overflow, white tower with red roof and ochre generator hall with red gabled roof and open switchyard.
Construction institute photo shows the thick circular weir rim, open center, bank wall, service landing, gallery and white red-roof tower.
Ministry exterior photo shows the intake tower and an inclined pair of gate rails into the reservoir.
